$comment: Crowberry Fen for Claude Code. Crowberry tint of Fen: dark, neutrals leaned toward crowberry (base #403654). Generated by build.mjs from src/ports/claude-code.json. Do not edit ports/claude-code/. Install: copy this file into ~/.claude/themes/ and pick it in /theme; Claude Code watches the folder and reloads without a restart (if the folder did not exist when Claude Code started, restart once). The file name is the theme's slug, stored as custom:crowberry-fen in your settings, so keep it; nothing is renamed and no version is bumped. Needs Claude Code 2.1.118 or newer for custom themes; effortUltra applies from 2.1.239; all 63 documented tokens are set, checked against the presets in 2.1.322. An older build ignores unknown tokens and invalid values one by one, so there is no partial state to guard. No environment is needed, but truecolour is: on a 256-colour terminal Claude Code rounds the hex values. Base: the built-in dark preset, so every token left unset falls back to it. Left unset: the terminal's own background and the body text of replies and the prompt, which Claude Code leaves to the terminal (pair this file with Darkberry's terminal port); syntax colours in diffs and code blocks, which Claude Code takes from its own highlighter; and the undocumented keys the presets carry (skill, autoAcceptShimmer, claudeBlue_FOR_SYSTEM_SPINNER, claudeBlueShimmer_FOR_SYSTEM_SPINNER, background, professionalBlue, chromeYellow, clawd_body, clawd_background). Shimmers are the spinner's moving highlight, chrome with no shared meaning: each is its token mixed 35% toward ui.text, which lightens on the dark flavours and darkens on Wisp, where a lighter sweep would vanish into cream. Structural palette names, each for a meaning only Claude Code shows, with the hue Claude Code's own dark preset gives it: juniper the plan-mode accent (teal), plum the accept-edits and ultracode accents and merged pull requests (purple), berry the shell-mode border (pink), apricot fast mode (orange), bilberry the IDE indicator, blueberry the memory indicator and the You label, the eight subagent colours by name (red cranberry, blue blueberry, green gooseberry, yellow honey, purple plum, orange apricot, pink berry, cyan juniper), the ultrathink rainbow (cranberry, apricot, honey, gooseberry, bilberry, lavender, plum), surface1 for the user-message, shell and memory entries (a message surface, as in T3 Code; surface0 is 2.3 from base on Mire and cannot be seen), surface2 for the hovered message (a hover fill is a surface step) and for the unfilled part of the usage meter. Host-owned pairings, measured with lib/color.mjs contrast() as Wisp / Fen / Mire / Blackwater: inverseText is ui.on.error, drawn by Claude Code on whichever token fills a badge; on claude 5.15 / 7.30 / 7.52 / 8.03, on the status colours 6.10 or better, on plum, juniper and ui.emphasis 6.09 or better. ui.text on surface1 6.23 / 6.10 / 10.70 / 11.70; ui.text.muted on surface1 4.04 / 4.01 / 7.32 / 7.73, under 4.5 on Wisp and Fen, where Claude Code draws hint text inside a message. Differs from Catppuccin (no catppuccin/claude-code exists; the reference is the community file plugins/theme-gallery/themes/catppuccin-mocha.json in livlign/ccthemes at a4f7528): the brand accent, the permission dialogs and the Claude label are tint, not blue, because tint is Darkberry's accent as readable text; suggestions are ui.emphasis rather than the accent; inactive text is ui.text.muted, not overlay0, because hints and timestamps are read; subtle is ui.text.subtle, not a surface, because Claude Code draws text in it as well as borders; the prompt border is ui.border.inactive (overlay1), not surface2, to clear 3:1; user, shell and memory entries share surface1 rather than three surface steps.
name: Crowberry Fen
